Namen van het park en de themagebieden (ZooParc Overloon, Boulders Beach, Outback, Jangalee, Ngorongoro, Itampolo, Ngyuwe, Headquarter, Basecamp) blijven zoals op zooparc.nl. 'Oorlogsmuseum Overloon' blijft de Nederlandse naam, met duiding 'war museum' in v3-p1. Kaart-naam en adres houden de Nederlandse naam.

titel: Hotel near ZooParc Overloon | Hotel Asteria Venray
omschrijving: Stay an 11-minute drive from ZooParc Overloon. After a day among the animals, the wellness area, the brasserie and your room at Hotel Asteria in Venray are waiting.
hero-sub: Seven themed areas and more than 80 animal species, an eleven-minute drive from your hotel room in Venray.
hero-alt: Two lions lying close together at ZooParc Overloon
v1-p1: From Hotel Asteria it is an 11-minute drive to ZooParc Overloon. The park is laid out as an expedition, with seven themed areas and more than 80 animal species. You walk from the penguins on Boulders Beach to the kangaroos in the Outback, past the tigers of Jangalee and the lions of Ngorongoro, and on to the lemurs of Itampolo.
v1-p2: The newest area is called Ngyuwe. Here you will find the okapi and the pygmy hippo, among others. According to the park, a visit takes three to four hours on average, so there is no need for an early alarm.
v1-alt: A ring-tailed lemur curiously reaching out a paw at ZooParc Overloon
v2-p1: There are feeding sessions every day, including at the capybaras, the lions and the giraffes. The times are in the park's daily programme. Take a quick look when you arrive and plan your route around them.
v2-p2: There are two places to eat and drink. Headquarter, the building where your expedition starts, is a self-service restaurant with sandwiches, soup and snacks. Basecamp is halfway along the route and handy for a coffee on the way.
v2-alt: A black-and-white ruffed lemur resting its arms on a branch
v3-kop: Two days out in one village
v3-p1: Overloon has another well-known name: the Oorlogsmuseum, its war museum. It is about 2.7 kilometres from ZooParc and has its own car park. If you start early, you can see the animals in the morning and the museum in the afternoon. It is more relaxed to make two days of it. The museum is a nine-minute drive from the hotel, so it is just as easy to plan for the next morning.
v3-alt: Military vehicle in a reconstructed beach scene at the Overloon War Museum
tip: Don't leave the indoor enclosures until last, as they close half an hour before the rest of the park. And book a table in our brasserie before you set off. Then there is nothing left to think about after the sauna.
g1-tekst: In winter too. The times for each day are on zooparc.nl.
g1-alt: A black-and-white ruffed lemur sitting on a tree trunk among the greenery
g2-tekst: Online from €20, at the gate €25. Children up to and including 2 years go free.
g2-alt: A red ruffed lemur sitting quietly on a tree trunk
g3-tekst: Own car park, €7.50 per car. You buy a parking token online or at the ticket desk.
g3-alt: Three Dalmatian pelicans together on a nest
g4-tekst: Pets are not allowed in the park. This also applies to assistance dogs.
g4-alt: A flamingo with its head tucked under its orange-pink feathers
dag-kop: How to make a day of it
dag-sub: Breakfast at the hotel, a day with the animals in Overloon and back in the late afternoon for the sauna and dinner.
m1-tekst: The breakfast buffet is served from 7 am to 10 am on weekdays and from 8 am to 10.30 am at weekends. Then get in the car: eleven minutes later you are in Overloon.
m1-alt: Basket of fresh bread rolls on the breakfast buffet at Hotel Asteria in Venray
m2-tekst: Allow three to four hours for the seven themed areas. Plan your route around the feeding sessions and have lunch at Headquarter or Basecamp.
m2-alt: Close-up of a capybara at ZooParc Overloon, with grass in the background
m3-tekst: Back in Venray, warm up in the sauna. The wellness area is open from 4 pm to 10 pm Monday to Thursday and from 12 noon to 10 pm Friday to Sunday. Tuesday is swimwear day.
m3-alt: Foot bath with green mosaic tiles under a skylight in the Top Floor wellness area at Hotel Asteria
m4-tekst: End the day at a table in the hotel brasserie. The kitchen is open until 9.30 pm, and afterwards your room is just a lift ride away.
m4-alt: Bartender pulling a beer at the brasserie bar in Hotel Asteria, Venray
kamers-sub: Then there is no need to drive home after the sauna and dinner. Choose your room; you will see the price for your dates straight away when you book.
kaart-regel: ZooParc Overloon lies north-west of Venray. The map also shows three other days out near the hotel.
kaart-alt: Map of North Limburg with Hotel Asteria in Venray, ZooParc Overloon and three other days out
f1-v: How far is ZooParc Overloon from Hotel Asteria?
f1-a: It is 10.4 kilometres, about 11 minutes by car. By bike it is 7.4 kilometres, around 35 minutes. You can hire bikes and e-bikes at our reception. Please note: there is no public transport to the park at weekends.
f2-v: How long does a visit to ZooParc Overloon take?
f2-a: According to the park, a visit takes three to four hours on average. After breakfast at the hotel you will be back in good time for the wellness area.
f3-v: Is ZooParc Overloon open in winter?
f3-a: Yes, the park is open every day of the year. Opening times vary by day and are on zooparc.nl. The indoor enclosures close half an hour before the rest of the park.
f4-v: How much are admission and parking?
f4-a: A ticket costs from €20 online and €25 at the gate per person. Children up to and including 2 years go free. Parking costs €7.50 per car. These are the prices from November 2026; check zooparc.nl for current prices. Parking at Hotel Asteria is free.
f5-v: Can I bring my dog to ZooParc?
f5-a: No. For the safety of the animals, pets are not allowed in the park. This also applies to assistance dogs.
f6-v: Can I still use the wellness area and have dinner at the hotel after ZooParc?
f6-a: Yes. The wellness area is open from 4 pm to 10 pm Monday to Thursday and from 12 noon to 10 pm Friday to Sunday. Tuesday is swimwear day. You can have dinner in the brasserie until 9.30 pm.

arcen.desc: More than fifteen gardens surround a 17th-century castle, from a rose garden and an oriental water garden to the tropical glasshouse Casa Verde. The Hertog Jan Brewery is in the same village, so it easily becomes a full day out. The gardens are closed in winter.
